code='''def transform(grid):
    """Collapse each non-background tile to 1 when it has multiple marks."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separators are complete rows/columns; non-separator runs are tiles.
    row_runs=[]
    start=0
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and all(v == 9 for v in grid[r]):
            if start < r:
                row_runs.append((start,r))
            start=r+1
    if start < h:
        row_runs.append((start,h))
    col_runs=[]
    start=0
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h)):
            if start < c:
                col_runs.append((start,c))
            start=c+1
    if start < w:
        col_runs.append((start,w))
    # The tile separator color is 9 in demonstrations; on the test it is 0.
    # Infer separator rows/columns as uniform lines whose value differs from
    # the non-separator cells.
    if not row_runs or len(row_runs) == 1:
        sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
        row_runs=[]
        s=0
        for r in sep_rows+[h]:
            if s<r: row_runs.append((s,r))
            s=r+1
    if not col_runs or len(col_runs) == 1:
        sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
        col_runs=[]
        s=0
        for c in sep_cols+[w]:
            if s<c: col_runs.append((s,c))
            s=c+1
    # Find the common background and mark color from tile contents.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sep_color=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # dominant tile color excluding separator cells; choose most common overall
    # color other than separator.
    bg=max((v for v in counts if v != sep_color), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    mark_colors=[v for v in counts if v not in (sep_color,bg)]
    mark=mark_colors[0] if mark_colors else None
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in row_runs:
        line=[]
        for c0,c1 in col_runs:
            n=sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) if mark is not None else 0
            line.append(1 if n>1 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    uniform_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    candidates = [grid[r][0] for r in uniform_rows]
    sep = max(set(candidates), key=candidates.count)
    row_runs=[]
    start=0
    for r in uniform_rows + [h]:
        if r < h and grid[r][0] != sep:
            continue
        if start < r:
            row_runs.append((start,r))
        start=r+1
    col_runs=[]
    start=0
    for c in uniform_cols + [w]:
        if c < w and grid[0][c] != sep:
            continue
        if start < c:
            col_runs.append((start,c))
        start=c+1
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark=max((v for v in counts if v != bg), key=lambda v: counts[v], default=None)
    return [[1 if mark is not None and sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) > 1 else bg
             for c0,c1 in col_runs] for r0,r1 in row_runs]
'''
